scope: Sanitized legacy-server parity: client compatibility, corrected emulator defects (project planning)

domains.title: Transport, authentication and startup
domains.implemented: Packet, cipher, startup and replacement-service paths exist; a limited local gameplay milestone was demonstrated on an earlier build.
domains.remaining: Complete native ownership and loader joins; verify the current published build and staged endpoint migration with the actual client.

domains.title: Shared player, items and persistence
domains.implemented: Concrete items/containers and managed snapshots exist. Bag and warehouse transfers persist complete item files before success; capacity, nested metadata, PIN and escrow paths are tested. Native component proof covers queues, spells/proficiencies, profile/subclass/ranking/mail/nobility owners and formats. Full native SaveClient and production caller adoption remain unfinished.
domains.remaining: Finish one shared native player/item graph, complete login-loader, real login/save worker and inventory mutation ordering, production caller integration, legacy SQL/provider compatibility and restart recovery.

domains.title: Combat, monsters and death
domains.implemented: Substantial spell, damage, receive, equipment, monster AI, rewards and death behavior has focused automated proof.
domains.remaining: Complete all callers, native arithmetic and shared RNG/order semantics, drops, lifetime ownership and multi-player/client scenarios.

domains.title: NPCs, shops, progression and housing
domains.implemented: Main dispatch, shops, forging, skill learning and durable progression/reward paths exist. Native quest definitions, eligibility, dialog and experience tables have component proof. House loading validates complete files before owner publication; authenticated housing adoption, entry and furniture gameplay remain unfinished.
domains.remaining: Close deferred mutations and exact economy/persistence ordering; complete housing, occupants and furniture lifecycle.

domains.title: Trade, social systems and events
domains.implemented: Managed Trade and player-booth exchanges use ordered pair commits and a shared journal. Tests cover complete closures, stale-file/escrow refusal, failure/retry, refunds/disconnect/restart and D13 Frame settlement. Warehouse composition preserves real 300-silver escrow: changed offered roots refund; unrelated withdrawals allow exchange. Guild/clan projections, selected actions, timers, score panels and some event state machines exist.
domains.remaining: Complete native/social/event ownership and real-client multiplayer acceptance. Broader inventory/storage and booth raw-writer/delivery lifecycles, remaining guild/union actions, brackets, rewards, claims, reset, database parity and durable recovery remain open; scoped managed tests do not certify all transfers.

domains.title: Cross-server and casino workflows
domains.implemented: Group/travel metadata, startup packets, poker data and visibility surfaces exist.
domains.remaining: Complete genuine transfer/return/session/economy ownership and failure handling; verify table rounds, betting, pot and settlement.

milestones.title: Limited local live-client milestone
milestones.detail: Login, walking, one-item drop/pickup and saving were demonstrated on an earlier isolated local build. This does not validate the latest public source.

milestones.title: Current public build live-client acceptance
milestones.detail: Not yet proven against the current published commit. Automated tests and prior local deployment proof are separate.

milestones.title: Complete English client
milestones.detail: Chinese client 7899 / cached DX8 D13 is the current target; English localization is incomplete.

milestones.title: Newer-client-only parity
milestones.detail: Not estimated. Features absent from the older server source require separate binary, data and observed-behavior evidence.

milestones.title: Public full-client download and updates
milestones.detail: Signed updater and original-art launcher tooling are published. No official full-client package/feed is published yet.
